descriptionChirho: The color blue/violet-blue, used primarily for sacred textiles and tabernacle furnishings. All 49 occurrences refer to the same color concept. S145149 covers standalone and conjunctive forms (eng 'blue', spa 'azul', arb 'أَزْرَقَ/أَسمانجونِيٍّ', kor '청색', swa 'bluu', hin 'नीला') while S145153 adds the prepositional prefix bet ('in the blue': eng 'in the blue', spa 'en el azul', arb 'بِالْأَسْمَانْجُونِيِّ', kor '청색으로', swa 'kwa buluu'). The split is purely grammatical — prepositional vs bare noun — not semantic.
